call_points.text: Major capex for Syngene and Biosimilars is fully funded through internal cash accruals.
Management expects performance to improve progressively as FY27 unfolds, especially with new products scaling up in the second half.
No numeric FY27 or FY28 guidance; management asked analysts to look at a broader multi-quarter window instead.
Net debt fell to $1.1 billion from more than $1.5 billion in March '25; free cash flow will first go to debt reduction.
Malaysia drug product Line 2 is being qualified and will be operational soon; drug substance doubling comes towards the end of FY27.
Generics EBITDA margin was 8%, up nearly 300 bps over Q3, on higher volumes and operating leverage.
Biosimilars Q4 EBITDA was ₹720 Cr, up 33% YoY, a 26% margin on improved revenue mix and operating leverage.
Management said to budget for some biosimilar price erosion in North America, though it gave no specific number.
Management highlights that the major investment phase is behind them and focus is shifting to execution and margin expansion.

operating_notes.text: Health Canada granted a Notice of Compliance on April 3, 2026 for Bosaya (denosumab, Prolia biosimilar) and Vevzuo (denosumab, Xgeva biosimilar).
Biocon says it has commercialised 12 biosimilar products and 30+ generic formulations globally, with 20+ biosimilar assets in the pipeline.

U.S. FDA pre-license inspection at Biocon's biosimilars site, Biocon Park, Bengaluru (April 20-29, 2026) covered 3 biologics manufacturing units, 5 quality testing laboratories and 2 warehouses, and ended with a Form 483 with five procedura
FY26 segment revenue: Biosimilars ₹1,04,312 million, CRDMO ₹37,387 million, Generics ₹31,681 million.
FY26 Generics segment posted a loss of ₹1,348 million versus a ₹1,755 million profit in FY25.
Biocon issued 91,967,019 shares (₹37,318 million) and paid ₹36,242 million cash to Mylan Inc to acquire 292,726,366 BBL shares.
Biosimilars Q4 FY26 revenue ₹2,756 Cr (+12% YoY) with segment EBITDA ₹720 Cr at a 26% margin; R&D was 7% of segment revenues.
Generics Q4 FY26 revenue ₹847 Cr, up 13% YoY adjusted for generic lenalidomide, with EBITDA of ₹75 Cr at an 8% margin.
CRDMO (Syngene) Q4 FY26 revenue ₹1,037 Cr, up 2% YoY and 13% QoQ, with FY26 revenue ₹3,739 Cr up 3% YoY.
Postal ballot concluded with approval of all 10 resolutions including remuneration revision, CEO appointment, preferential issuance, and board changes.
Generics API-to-formulations split was about 60:40 this quarter versus historically two-thirds/one-third.
Biosimilar days of inventory outstanding normalised to about 280-290 from more than 400 in the past.
Interest cost was ₹213 Cr in Q1FY27 versus about ₹280 Cr a year ago, a 23% decline.
Signed licensing deal with Janssen for Yesintek™ (biosimilar Stelara®) across Australia, Brazil, China, Hong Kong, Israel, Mexico, New Zealand, South Korea and Kazakhstan.

timeline.summary: 2026-04-21: Biocon said Health Canada granted a Notice of Compliance on April 3, 2026 for Bosaya (denosumab, Prolia biosimilar) and Vevzuo (denosumab, Xgeva biosimilar).
2026-04-30: U.S. FDA completed a pre-license inspection at Biocon's biosimilars site in Biocon Park, Bengaluru (April 20-29, 2026) and issued a Form 483 with five procedural observations.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹4,516.6 Cr (+2.3% YoY), net profit to shareholders ₹125.9 Cr.
2026-05-07: Biocon reported Q4FY26 total income of ₹4,569 Cr and FY26 total income of ₹17,270 Cr, recommending a final dividend of Re. 0.50 per share.
Biocon reported Q4FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹4,517 Cr and EBITDA of ₹1,073 Cr, completing the integration of Biocon Biologics.
Biocon Limited shared Q4 FY26 earnings call audio/video recording link on May 8, 2026, via U Shanoy, Company Secretary.
2026-05-11: Biocon Pharma received Health Canada approval for micafungin for injection, USP, 50 mg and 100 mg.
Biocon reported Q4 FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹4,517 Cr and EBITDA of ₹1,073 Cr.
2026-06-08: Biocon announced voting results and scrutinizer's report for postal ballot approving CEO appointment and board changes.
2026-10-14: Biocon settles global patent with Genentech, securing earliest licensed launch dates for Pebrilzo® (bPertuzumab) to launch in EU/UK Q1CY27 and US Q3CY28
Biocon signed a licensing deal with Janssen to commercialise biosimilar Stelara® (Yesintek™) in 9 additional global markets including China and Brazil.
